data.label: include
data.reason_zh: AIDE^2 以自身代码为优化对象，用基准评测反馈筛选改写，被接受的改写成为下一轮被编辑的智能体，形成持续自改进闭环。

scope_support.feedback_quote: benchmarks modified versions of itself on a suite of AI R&D tasks, and keeps the changes that perform best on hidden evaluations
scope_support.object_quote: It proposes changes to its own code
scope_support.persistence_quote: each accepted rewrite becomes the agent that the next round edits
